content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the main plant hormones and their functions
Describe how auxin controls plant growth responses
Understand the role of other plant hormones

(also called plant growth regulators) are chemicals that control and coordinate plant growth and responses to the environment. Unlike animals, plants cannot move to find resources, so they use hormones to grow towards light and water, and to coordinate processes like flowering and fruit development.
Produced in one part of plant
Plants don't have a circulatory system
Hormones move through transport tissues and by diffusion
